execution: Explicit replay in a fresh isolated Python Worker; sequential commands; unconditional Worker reset on success/failure/cancellation. Import reads text without replay.

projectField.name: libraryRecipe
projectField.validation: Bounded input draft; unfinished or invalid JSON text is preserved for editing. No result or object state is restored.

semanticRules: Unique step IDs; references only to earlier steps. Paths traverse own properties, at most 8 components.
Public target belongs to the declared module; private paths and Python source are not recipe operations.
Pin exactly used ht/fluids packages, including $function dependencies; match the whole prepared package revision before creating any Worker.
payload.handle and $object use logical references, never imported live handle strings.
Other output references transport JSON values; typed output records require explicit compatible input tags. No automatic output-to-input coercion or unit conversion.
call accepts args/kwargs; get and release do not execute additional Python text. All executed methods still use the existing public library bridge.
Stop on first failed command. Partial results retain error/cancelled status; no later command runs.
Results retain engine and consistent Worker implementation revision; object descriptors become summaries without live handles.
Project input edits, navigation or cancellation discard a pending result. Delayed file import cannot overwrite newer edits.
The isolated scenario does not invalidate existing raw-library objects.
Version-pinned commands do not make time-dependent, random or externally dependent functions deterministic. Their dependencies and controls remain per-function review work.

controlledGeometry.shape: Vertical straight circular cylinder, default flat/no shaped heads
controlledGeometry.tolerance: 1e-10*max(1,abs(reference)) for volume/level; 1e-12 m3 for the three table points. These are integration/arithmetic control tolerances, not physical-model uncertainty.

set_table.typeQualification: Signature annotates n as int while the docstring says float; the controlled case uses int, without a general coercion claim.
